description.value: Tamitik Arena is a municipal ice rink in Kitimat, BC, operated by the District of Kitimat and used primarily for ice hockey. It is listed alongside the Kitimat Ice Rink and Riverlodge Recreation and Fitness Centre as part of the city's recreation portfolio, suggesting it serves both organized sport and public recreation. For touring cyclists passing through the northwest BC community of Kitimat, it represents one of the town's main indoor recreation facilities.

However, the District of Kitimat sitemap subpage confirms Tamitik Arena exists as an active municipal facility listed under 'Recreation & Culture > Kitimat Recreation and Community Centres'. OSM tags (leisure=ice_rink, sport=ice_hockey) confirm it is a public ice arena. No specific amenity, address, or phone details for the arena itself could be extracted from the available content.
